`minds-admin server prep` / `server setup` now assign a gen-2 box's management overlay address (`bare_metal_servers.wireguard_address`) under a transaction-scoped Postgres advisory lock, reading the stamped set and stamping the chosen address in one transaction. Two concurrent setups on one tier used to each read the free set before the other had stamped and take the same address (seen on production on 2026-09-15); a concurrent allocation now waits for the first to commit and picks the next one.
